subject.title: fix(agents): protect provider auth exchange output by sensitivity, not input marker

question: After the failing caller-contract tests are updated, should provider runtime-auth treat every non-empty, non-canonical-marker output as sensitive by default?
rationale: The patch fixes a demonstrated credential leak and matches the documented exchange contract, but it intentionally defines permanent behavior for bundled and external provider plugins.

options.title: Approve output-sensitive protection
options.body: Treat provider runtime-auth results as credentials by default and require inert outputs to use canonical declared markers.

options.title: Add provider-declared sensitivity
options.body: Extend the Plugin SDK so each runtime-auth output field explicitly declares sensitivity before landing the shared change.

options.title: Narrow to Mantle only
options.body: Repair the confirmed Mantle leak locally while retaining the existing shared classification rule.

recommendation.title: Approve output-sensitive protection
recommendation.body: Treat provider runtime-auth results as credentials by default and require inert outputs to use canonical declared markers.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the shared sentinel egress boundary and current guard, making him the strongest history-backed owner for its permanent security contract.
